items.title: Hyperallergic Fall 2026 New York Art Guide
items.summary: From Brancusi’s modernism to Krasner and Pollock’s midcentury stylings to Arthur Jafa’s contemporary lens, there’s something for everyone this season.

items.title: Police Break Into Vancouver Gallery After Confusing Sculpture for Person
items.summary: A passerby called 911 earlier this month after interpreting the protruding legs of an anthropomorphic sculpture as a person in need of medical assistance.

items.title: Major Queer Art Auction Features Peaches, Chappell Roan, and Chani Nicholas
items.summary: Dozens of donated artworks, archival media, experiences, and collectibles that embody the queer canon are available through the second annual Queer | Art x Doll Invasion fundraiser exhibition.

items.title: Virginia and Leonard Woolf's Hogarth Press Gets an Exhibition of Its Own
items.summary: They were both writers, and amongst the remarkable fruits of their union was a decision to open a small press, which in time grew into something far from small.
